final.role: Codigo de pesquisa para pre-treino de modelos de linguagem multilingues e extracao de features (XLM-R, 100 idiomas); base possivel para embeddings, nao e busca pronta.
final.evidence: PyTorch original implementation of Cross-lingual Language Model Pretraining; XLM-R is trained on 2.5 TB of CommonCrawl data, in 100 languages; xlmr.extract_features. README is truncated before the language list reaches Portuguese.

auditoria.nota: Old research training code (PyTorch 0.4/1.0); the hub would use a packaged multilingual embedding model instead, never this repo directly.
